fusions.name: Pelting Drops
fusions.desc: Looses 5 drops at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloudburst Drop
fusions.desc: Hurls you down onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 16 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range, and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Drip Dry
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Coat
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, you gain a shield that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
